- The introduction process of receiving work permits can be found in Chapter 7 Receive the Electronic Document. [1]

- Foreign students who earn an associate degree or higher in Taiwan can apply to extend their stay in the country for up to two years. [1]

- The 1990 hotline for foreigners in Taiwan is called 1990 [1]
- It is also referred to as 業務諮詢一覽表 (1990 外來人士在臺生活諮詢服務熱線) [1]
- Call 165 for scams that use money, internet, or phone games. [1]

- If an employer does not enroll a student worker in labor insurance, they will be fined 4× the labor insurance fee and 10× the employment insurance fee for the period the employer fails to enroll. [1]
- If the employer does not submit the required labor pension (勞保、勞退2合1加保申報表) and does not submit the required employment pension, they will be fined 4× the labor insurance fee and 10× the employment insurance fee for the period the employer fails to enroll. [3]

- A bachelor's degree takes four years and at least 128 credits in total. [1]
- Your department may require more; its curriculum table has the exact number. [1]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- 12 additional graduation credits are required for overseas students admitted on an equivalent qualification, including 12 additional graduation credits from military training and physical education. [1]
- Courses taken in the previous paragraph do not count toward the 12 additional graduation credits. [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- At least 16 credits each semester in the first, second, and third academic years [1]
- At least 9 credits each semester in the fourth academic year [1]

- International students must take the full‑year five‑credit course “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” (僑生國文) [1]
- They are not required to take “Chinese (B): Chinese Writing” [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw [1]

- Take 6 credits of Mandarin courses at the Language Center instead of the freshman Chinese. [1]
- File for the Chinese course substitution before you graduate. [1]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Students are required to take five physical education courses in five semesters (Freshman PE I, Freshman PE II, and three PE interest electives) [1]
- These courses carry no graduation credits and cannot be repeated with the same title [1]
- After completing the five semesters, students may take an additional 1‑credit PE course, which also does not count toward graduation [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw [1]

- A master's degree requires at least 24 credits, not counting thesis credits. [1]
- You must take at least one graduate course of 1 credit or more at NCU; waived courses do not count. [1]

- Students admitted directly into a doctoral program must complete at least 34 credits, including at least 18 doctoral-level credits. [1]
- Dissertation credits are excluded from this total. [1]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Apply before the add/drop deadline of your first semester; the application will be reviewed individually. [1]
- If approved, you will skip both semesters of Freshman English and receive 6 credits that count toward graduation. [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Undergraduates need at least 100 service hours on the NCU passport before they can receive the degree certificate. [1]
- Check your hours on the Service Learning Website or in the Graduation System. [1]
- If you fail to complete the minimum of 100 service hours, you will not be able to receive the degree certificate. [1]
- For questions, contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心) at https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/. [1]

- Service learning is not listed among the graduation conditions for master's and doctoral students. [1]
- Graduation requires completing all required courses and credits, passing the degree examination, and maintaining satisfactory conduct grades each semester. [1]
- Individual departments may set additional requirements. [1]
- For more information, contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心) at https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/. [1]

- The service-learning course is required for two semesters with different course numbers. [2]
- The course does not count toward the number of credits for graduation. [2]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [2]

- IELTS score of 5.5 (admitted 115 or later) [2]
- Linguaskill LR score of 145 (admitted 114 or earlier) or 150 (admitted 115 or later) [2]
- BESTEP total score of 700 with listening 90, reading 90, speaking 260, writing 260 [2]

- TOEIC LR: 600 (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- TOEFL ITP: 483 (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- TOEFL IBT: 64 (2026-01-21 新制成績為 3.5 級) (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- IELTS: 5.0 (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- GEPT HI First: 143 (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- BESTEP LR: 170 (admitted 110 or later) [1]

- The program requires an English proficiency certificate at CEFR B1 (Threshold) or above. [1]
- Example scores include TOEFL iBT: 42; IELTS: 4; TOEIC: 550; GEPT: Intermediate. [3]
- Regulations: https://www.lst.ncu.edu.tw/NLT_new/page.php?slug=method&lang=en [1]
- Mon-Fri 9:00-17:00 (Taipei time, UTC+8) [2]

- Take bus 132 or 133 from any stop on campus towards Zhongli; the ride takes about 20–30 minutes. [1]
- Bus 132 ends at Zhongli Bus Station, a short walk from the train station. [1]

- The monthly stipend for students of the INTENSE Program is NT$30,000. [3]
- The disbursement timing depends on the date of the IIPP funds credited. [3]
- For more details, contact Ms. Kelly Chien, Tel: 03-422-7151 Ext. 57080. [3]
- Eligible nationalities: Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand [1]
- Application period is from Dec. 1 to Dec. 29 [1]

- Pick up at the OIA counter [1]
- Bring your student ID or passport/visa/ARC (only for first-time applicants) [1]
- Hours: Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 (Taipei time, UTC+8) [1]
- Aug. 1-Aug. 27 Graduate Students Apply for Credits Assessment for Student Loans [1]
- Aug. 31- Sep. 4 Orientation Week for New International Students [1]

- The fee for the Taiwan Area Residence Certificate for a Hong Kong or Macau student applying for the first time is NTD 1,000 per item per year. [1]
- The entry-exit permit fee for a Hong Kong/Macau student is NTD 2,200 per single entry/exit permit. [1]

- 勞動部「外國專業人員工作許可申辦網」(https://ezwp.wda.gov.tw/) [3]
- 申請流程及進度可於「外國專業人員工作許可申辦網」線上申辦 [3]

- 畢業後，若欲在臺尋求工作，可申請以「其他」事由延期居留1年，有必要再申請1次，總延期居留效期最長可達2年。 [1]
- 重新發放證號碼，並重新核准工作居留期限。 [3]

- 學士班畢業至少 128 學分 [2]
- 本校採學年學分制，學士班學生修業期限均為四年，所修學分總數，不得少於 128 學分 [2]
- 各系的畢業學分可能更高，以系上應修科目表為準 [2]

- 學士班學生須完成至少 100 基本時數，否則無法領取學位證書。 [1]
- 可至【服務學習網】或【畢業審核系統】查詢完成時數。 [1]
- 如有疑問，請洽學務處服務學習發展中心。 [1]
- 相關資訊可於 https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/ 查閱。 [1]

- 托福 ITP 需 543 (admitted 115 or later) [3]
- 托福 ITP 需 600 (admitted 114 or earlier) 或 785（聽力 400、閱讀 385） (admitted 115 or later) [3]

- 國泰人壽保險公司：109-110 年自行負擔560 元 [2]
- 對象：海外直接分發或單招入學，在臺未住滿6個月之僑生 [2]
- 保期：效期6個月 [2]

- 每月保費為新臺幣1,377元。 [1]
- 陸生自付6成（826元），政府負擔4成（551元）。 [1]

- 從校內任一公車站搭乘 132 或 133 公車到中壢，車程約 20–30 分鐘。 [1]

- 乘車時間為約 20–30 分鐘。 [1]
